{"code":"import json, pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timezone
j=json.load(open('query'))
rows=[]
for f in j['features']:
 p=f['properties']; d=datetime.fromtimestamp(p['time']/1000, tz=timezone.utc).date().isoformat()
 rows.append((d,p['mag']))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['date','mag'])
g=df.groupby('date').agg(n=('mag','size'),lo=('mag','min'),hi=('mag','max'))
g['range']=g.hi-g.lo
print(g.sort_values(['range','date'],ascending=[False,True]).head(10).to_string())
"}

arguments.code:
import json, pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime, timezone
j=json.load(open('query'))
rows=[]
for f in j['features']:
 p=f['properties']; d=datetime.fromtimestamp(p['time']/1000, tz=timezone.utc).date().isoformat()
 rows.append((d,p['mag']))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['date','mag'])
g=df.groupby('date').agg(n=('mag','size'),lo=('mag','min'),hi=('mag','max'))
g['range']=g.hi-g.lo
print(g.sort_values(['range','date'],ascending=[False,True]).head(10).to_string())
